public_definitions: The task is to review the screening referral dashboard and assign the record to the operational follow-up pathway that best fits the referral pattern over the reporting period.
The dashboard is the evidence source for selecting the appropriate screening referral follow-up pathway.
The three options for the follow-up pathway are: 'Route to growth-focused referral follow-up', 'Route to reduction-focused referral follow-up', and 'Route to standard referral monitoring'.
uncertain: The chart title includes the word 'Reduced', which may be misleading given the upward trend shown in the graph. The dashboard summary subtitle may be a general description rather than a specific indicator of the referral pattern's direction.
